title: DEP-SEC: defer #279 @vitejs/plugin-vue major to Tranche C; fix Dependabot labels
intent: Close the actionable risk surface on Dependabot PR #279 without merging the major. Remove invalid dependabot.yml labels that Dependabot cannot apply, ignore @vitejs/plugin-vue semver-major alongside vite/vitest (Tranche C coupling), and record a durable disposition document with landing criteria and sibling-PR findings (#280-#283).
behavior_change: Intake-only. No packages/client version or lockfile mutation. Dependabot will no longer open @vitejs/plugin-vue major PRs; label application errors stop because labels are omitted.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) .github/dependabot.yml: remove labels dependencies/javascript (repo labels do not exist; Dependabot cited this on #279). (2) Add ignore for @vitejs/plugin-vue semver-major with Tranche C rationale. (3) Add docs/ci/DEP_SEC_PR279_PLUGIN_VUE_DISPOSITION_2026-08-18.md risk table, fixes, additional issues (#280-#283), and landing criteria.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: vite/vitest majors were already ignored, but plugin-vue majors were not — producing #279 while vite remains held. Labels were invalid since dependabot.yml creation. No prior document dispositioned #279.
